Visualizations
Design Load Envelope
Burst Envelope — Pressure vs Depth (TVD)
Design Load Required (×SF) Rating
Burst scenario (worst case): Gas kick reaches surface — casing filled with gas (0.1 psi/ft gradient) from shoe to surface. Net burst at any depth = Formation P at shoe − gas column − external mud. MASP capped at FG − 0.5 ppg.
Collapse Envelope — Pressure vs Depth (TVD)
Design Load Required (×SF) Rating
Collapse scenario (per StressCheck): Conductor: seawater inside. Surface: Lost Returns with Water (fresh water 0.36 psi/ft). Intermediate: Lost Returns with Mud Drop (gas 0.1 psi/ft). Production/Liner: Full Evacuation (0 psi). SF = 1.0.
Axial (Tension) Envelope — Force vs Depth
Axial worst case: Static (buoyancy-corrected hanging weight) + Shock load (1,780 × 2 ft/s × wt ppf) + Bending (63 × DLS × OD × wt). DF = 1.6 fixed per StressCheck.

Design Limits — Triaxial Ellipse
String:
Run Calculate first to generate design limits.
Design Limits — Effective Differential Pressure vs Axial Force
Ellipse basis: Von Mises triaxial yield criterion (API TR 5C3 §11): (σ_a/Yp)² − (σ_a/Yp)(σ_t/Yp) + (σ_t/Yp)² = 1  →  Ellipse with axes at Burst=Yp and Collapse=−Yp. Loads plotted as (Axial Force kN, Net Differential Pressure MPa). Points inside ellipse = PASS. Design factor applied to ellipse boundary (shrinks envelope).
